{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Extract the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').mean()

print(f"Fraction of enrolled patients with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
